body.claim: A consumer price index tracks the price of a shopping "basket" of what households buy.
body.why: It is the weighted average price of a market basket of consumer goods and services. Prices are collected, often monthly, from a sample of shops and services. The items in the basket are updated periodically to reflect changes in consumer spending habits.

probes.question: A consumer price index is a weighted average price of what?
options: A market basket of consumer goods and services

probes.question: True or false: the items in the basket are updated periodically to reflect changes in spending habits.

claims.claim: A CPI tracks the price of a basket of what households buy
claims.quote: a statistical estimate of the level of prices of goods and services bought for consumption purposes by households

claims.claim: It is the weighted average price of a market basket of consumer goods and services (probe p1)
claims.quote: It is calculated as the weighted average price of a market basket of consumer goods and services.

claims.claim: Prices are collected, often monthly, from a sample of shops and services
claims.quote: The prices of the goods and services in the basket are collected (often monthly) from a sample of retail and service establishments.

claims.claim: Basket items are updated periodically to reflect changes in spending habits (probe p2)
claims.quote: The items in the basket are updated periodically to reflect changes in consumer spending habits.
